messages:
maya: Quick crossover shift check-in (2539876543).
maya: What I did: rolled kv-cache eviction tweak (rev 462) to blue cluster. Verified warmups on canary.
maya: Blockers: seeing intermittent tokenization 500s on /v1/stream endpoints for requests >2048 tokens. Logs show "kv-miss" and downstream grpc retry.
maya: Today: debug alert noise, correlate with autoscaler, follow up on runbook updates. tagging @ryan for tracing assist.

ryan: Thanks — looking now. Seeing spiky latency in pod rtx-ml-3 around 03:12 UTC. I pulled traces: trace_id=0a1b2c3d. Will run flame graphs.
ryan: Early suspicion: KEDA scale-down hitting warmup window. Could be interleaving with prefix-cache eviction.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT: alert_inc_8821 - high 5xx rate on /v1/stream. Severity: P2. Link: https://internal.inc/alerts/8821

olivia: FYI I just pushed a small patch to increase prefetch concurrency to 4 for the worker. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/777

samir: I'll take on the immediate pager for next 90m and keep the channel updated.

maya: thx @samir. Can you run `kubectl logs -l app=rtx-ml -c server --tail=200 | grep kv-miss` and paste the first few lines?

samir: pasted logs below:
```
[2026-03-17T03:12:07Z] kv-miss key=seq:984 client=api-45 id=0a1b2c3d
[2026-03-17T03:12:08Z] grpc: retry attempt=1 target=embed-service
[2026-03-17T03:12:09Z] kv-miss key=prefix:hello client=api-67 id=0f2e3d4c
```

ryan: Looks like 2 distinct clients, one long sequence. Rollback suggestion: revert eviction for keys with prefix "seq:" and add a 30s grace window.

maya: Agree. I can patch config and roll a canary in 10m. Will also update runbook note under "kv-eviction -> don't evict seq:*".

jess: Quick note — SLO dashboard shows error budget burn +0.6% last 6h. If we exceed 1% we'll trigger oncall escalation. Keep an eye.

olivia: pushed prefetch patch, testing on canary pod rtx-ml-canary-5.

samir: Canary looks OK so far, 0 5xx in 5m. I'll watch for 20m then promote.

maya: Good. Also filing follow-up ticket to add instrumentation for prefix eviction metrics. assigning to @olivia.

maya: thanks everyone, I'll post final once canary promotes.
